verdict.rationale: Fastmail offers a developer-facing JMAP API with token auth, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, test account tier, or non-production API endpoint. The JMAP session docs point only to the production api.fastmail.com endpoint, and multi-account login is an adjacent feature, not a sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
